mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuation multiples through increased discount rates on future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1.5 million units signals weakening residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500.0), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as tighter labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100.0), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where RSAFS declines and HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation below 1.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, prompting accommodative monetary policy that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations expand.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
